name: iZIP
summary: ADSL/dialup + hosting ISP (iZIP, Oznett group, ~2006); defunct (IAN DUKE MCLEAN (sole trader), ABN 78 710 747 365).

events.details: Ceased as an ISP — domain now a computer-support business.. iZIP sold ADSL/dialup/wireless into Apr 2013 and went repairs-only by May 2014 — ISP death c. 2013-14; the c. 2009 entry mistook the 2009 shop-closure notice for the ISP's end.

refs.label: Domain now serves an unrelated Brisbane computer-repair business — no internet plans
Homepage still offered retail internet access plans 8 Apr 2013 (the Aug 2009 'Specialty Shop closed' notice behind the current 2009 death referred only to the N
By 16 May 2014 the homepage was a computer-repairs WordPress site with no access plans; that support site persists to 2026.
Operator entity active in 2026 (Brisbane QLD 4157, onsite computer support) — alive but no longer a retail ISP.
